# User Model. Behavioral Predictions

> **Template.** Copy to `memory/user-model.md`. This file is meant to be AUTO-generated and updated by
> your nightly consolidation ("dreaming") job, not hand-written, though you can seed it by hand. Each
> entry is a behavioral PREDICTION with a confidence tag, derived from observed sessions. Distinct
> from USER.md (which is the deep qualitative model): this file is the falsifiable, pattern-matched,
> continuously-updated prediction layer. When a prediction is confirmed or violated, update its
> confidence rather than deleting it.

*Auto-generated by the consolidation job. Updated nightly. Confidence per prediction.*

---

> **Maintenance notes.**
> - Confidence tiers: `low` (one observation) -> `medium` (2-3, or one strong signal) -> `high`
>   (repeated across sessions or an explicit verbatim rule from the operator).
> - Snapshots go stale fast: do NOT embed live deal/project state here. Point to the Tier-2 dossier
>   that owns it instead. A dated snapshot in this file will outlive its shelf life and mislead.
> - When a prediction is violated, record the violation and drop confidence, don't silently delete it.
>   A falsified prediction is data.
